Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The petitioners apprehend arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1247 of 2019 dated 26.07.2019, instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 323 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The prosecution case, in short, is that complainant stated in her complaint case that her marriage was solemnized to petitioner no. 1 thirty five years ago.
Three daughters and one son have born to her out of their wedlock.

She was subjected to Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.62073 of 2023(2)
dt.16-10-2023 cruelty and torture by petitioner no. 1 and petitioner no. 1 solemnized his second marriage to petitioner no. 2 (Israt Khatoon).

The complainant further disclosed that in the year 2018, after assault she was ousted from her matrimonial home and she has been living in a rented Mohammad Amin Miyan @ Md. Amin vs The State Of Bihar on 16 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97078934/
1 house since then.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and they have been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that marriage took place between the complainant and the petitioner no. 1 more than 39 years ago from today having four children and petitioner no. 1 solemnized his second marriage twenty years ago with the consent of the informant.
It is submitted that nothing has been mentioned against the petitioners in the complaint case.
It is submitted that petitioner no. 2 is aged about 45 years and is second wife of petitioner no. 1.
Lastly, it has been submitted that they have no criminal antecedents.
5. Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioners.

6. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions of learned counsel for the parties, in the event of arrest / surrender of the petitioners in connection with Complaint Case No. 1247 of 2019, they shall be released Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.62073 of 2023(2)
dt.16-10-2023 on anticipatory bail upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Judicial Magistrate-Ist Class (West), Muzaffarpur, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Khatim Reza, J) prabhat/-
